title: A metrics module that outgrows its module-global counters

initial_repo.README.md:
# metrics

Little metrics module. See git history for the design conversation.

stages.message: A tiny metrics module, metrics.py: inc(name) bumps a counter and get(name) reads it (0 for a counter nobody has bumped). No need for a class or anything — we just import the module wherever we need it. Write tests.

I know I said no class needed, but the new test harness wants isolated metric sets so tests don't bleed into each other. A Metrics class with the same inc/get would do it — and keep the module-level inc/get working too, old callers still use those.

requirements.text: a Metrics class with inc/get; instances are isolated from each other; module-level inc/get keep working on a default instance

hidden_tests.test_stage2_instances.py:
import metrics
from metrics import Metrics


def test_instances_are_isolated():
    a = Metrics()
    b = Metrics()
    a.inc("hits")
    b.inc("hits")
    b.inc("hits")
    assert a.get("hits") == 1
    assert b.get("hits") == 2
    assert Metrics().get("hits") == 0


def test_module_level_still_works_and_is_its_own_instance():
    metrics.inc("boot")
    metrics.inc("boot")
    assert metrics.get("boot") == 2
    assert Metrics().get("boot") == 0  # not shared with fresh instances

stages.message: The web folks want Prometheus-style labels now: inc('requests', labels={'path': '/a'}). The same label set counts separately, no labels is its own series, and get without labels returns the total across the label sets.

requirements.text: inc/get accept labels; each label set is a separate series; get without labels returns the total

hidden_tests.test_stage3_labels.py:
from metrics import Metrics


def test_labeled_series_count_separately():
    m = Metrics()
    m.inc("requests", labels={"path": "/a"})
    m.inc("requests", labels={"path": "/a"})
    m.inc("requests", labels={"path": "/b"})
    m.inc("requests")
    assert m.get("requests") == 4
    assert m.get("requests", labels={"path": "/a"}) == 2
    assert m.get("requests", labels={"path": "/b"}) == 1
    assert m.get("requests", labels={"path": "/c"}) == 0


def test_unknown_counters_are_zero():
    m = Metrics()
    assert m.get("nope") == 0
    assert m.get("nope", labels={"a": "1"}) == 0
